recipe.loss: All original case nodes, unchanged TRAIN-only signed4 encoding, mean squared error over N times4; one complete FNO body/backward/Adam update
recipe.sampling: Existing stored480 case order: four PythonRandom2026 shuffled full120-case passes, independent of model RNG; each case exactly four updates
recipe.initialization: Two fresh arms, identical field constructor/seed/parameter layout/order, no warm start. Only current-load columns supplied to the shared latent body differ; natural initial predictions need not match.
recipe.candidate: linear_basis clears cached grid11:17 (original features7:13 normalized force/moment6) before FNO lift; geometry/global32/support/material/load location retained
recipe.control: load_dependent_basis retains current normalized load6 in same latent body; still the same9 basis head and independent load-conditioned stress head
recipe.load_coefficients: alpha=features7:13 @ shared feature_to_alpha3x6.T; actual physical loads=features7:13 times[42300N three,565000Nmm three], reject out-of-span load; no caseID input
recipe.u_units: HeadV[k,j]=B[k,j]/existing std_j with zero center. encoded_u=sum(alpha*V)-mean/std once; physical_u=std*sum(alpha*V). Never sum centered per-basis encodings.
recipe.stress: Independent latent16 plus actual normalized load6 to128 to1 head outputs original signed scalar stress encoding; no abs or scalar stress superposition
recipe.selection: Fixed480 endpoint primary, common knownVAL15 score0.5*(case-mean physical U relativeL2+signedstress relativeL2); validation-best secondary, never training-best
recipe.precision: Same float32/TF32/noautocast and original real-stored four-quadrant spectral weights/fused Adam as old FNO screen
recipe.timing: Primary train_seconds starts before current normal load_case and includes grid/query-cache/target reads,H2D,FNO allnode forward/backward,Adam,sync. Shared lazy input-guard build/read measured separately; raw totalwall includes it. Allnode inference timer starts after normal input/H2D as old FNO. Evaluationwall includes loads/guards, so these timing fields overlap and are not summed as disjoint costs.

configuration.frequency_semantics: Frozen geobc.fno.SpectralConv3d four-quadrant m12; real/imag stored separately, not NeuralOperator total-modes12
configuration.stress_load_policy: Append the same live normalized physical F/M6 to latent16 in both arms
configuration.effective_capacity: Stored parameter layout matches; clearing load columns reduces active conditioning, so equal effective capacity is not claimed

geometry_encoder.coordinates: Same fixed xyz-only cloud; independent of current load/targets

model.input_schema: grid29=occupancy1+xyz3+original25; append live global32; load6 separately uses original25 slots7:13

output_schema.u_basis: V[k,j]=physical u for canonical basis[k] divided by existing TRAIN std[j], zero-centered; nine values are not individually mean-centered field encodings
output_schema.stress: Independent nonlinear force-conditioned scalar head in existing asinh/center/std encoding; no scalar superposition or constitutive GT claim

load_metadata.support: Existing45 TRAIN/validation guard; no new CAD or field-relation verification

query_equivalence.equation: T(sum(alpha*V)-mu/std)=sum(alpha*T(V))-mu/std when each static trilinear row sums to1
query_equivalence.scope: alpha constant across case, T linear; means applied once. Actual FP32 row-weight/accumulation/scaler rounding can differ, so no bitwise equivalence or exact-zero numerical claim
query_equivalence.runtime_verification: Deferred to first actual case; author AST only, no model/toy/probe

model.parameter_count_policy: sum(numel) of actual public trainable real tensors; spectral complex values use a final real/imag axis2 and count both components; buffers excluded
model.stored_initialization_policy: Both arms same constructor, seed, tensor layout and order. Natural predictions differ from changed inputs; old direct4 FNO is not a matched control
model.gradient_policy: Current known one-hot alpha may give zero gradients in inactive basis output rows; require finite gradients and positive aggregate active-head/trunk/encoder gradient, not all9 rows positive
limitations: Only verified load span, not arbitrary six-component loading
Geometry/BC accuracy and engineering small-deformation validity unproven
No predicted-strain to source scalar stress identity
No old-final or sealed-test input/target access
